name: Flow part measures
responsibility: Answers the size of each part a sequence or a flowchart places, measured from the sizes the painter draws it with, so a flow layout never reads the painter's sizes
description: Ten operations, re-exported from lib.rs over a private folder module (ADR 0088): sequence_cards(cards, ColumnLimits) -> HeadCards { width, lifeline_drop, cards } fits each participant's title (the title steps and ICON_MIN_CARD_WIDTH live here, fitted_size is private) under the column policy the layout passes; message_plate(label, room) and note_plate(note, wrap) wrap and size a message's and a step note's plate; message_ends(kind, from_x, to_x, busy) takes the column centres and answers where an arrow starts and stops, standoff and head included; activation_span(centre) is a getter with an argument (the layout reads a bar's half width from it); self_loop(start) -> Rect; fragment_head(operator, words, guards) -> FragmentHead is measured once where a frame is placed and carried in its rows; fragment_bounds(ink, columns, head) -> Span applies the side padding and the head's least width, so side padding never leaves the measure; flow_tab(frame_width, has_summary) answers the tab and the heading; shape_words(name, width) wraps a flowchart shape's words. The sizes come from the crate-private sheet (sizes.rs) that the painter draws by. TASK-653.20.
